Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, H.L. GOKHALE
RAILWAYS ACT, 1989: ss. 11 (a) and (g) - Construction of electric supply lines by Railways - Held: Provisions of Railways Act clearly authorize the Railways to construct necessary transmission lines, dedicated for their own purpose - NTPC, company, does have the necessary authority to enter into a power purchasing agreement u/s 43A of Electric (Supply) Act, 1948 - Thus, the action of Railways of constructing transmission lines and drawing power from thermal power plants of NTPC was perfectly legal - Electricity E (Supply) Act,
Decision Date : 09-02-2012 | Case No : TRANSFERRED CASE (CIVIL) No. 37/2001 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
